answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake of 500 POA before trading, released only after 30 days of honest behavior. When a gale of fake identities floods in, each one pays the same stake, so spinning up 1,000 sock puppets costs 500,000 POA up front — far more than any single scam can earn. Like a willow that bends but holds its roots, the stake tolerates honest mistakes yet snaps on proven fraud: detected duplicates forfeit the whole deposit, and saffron-priced resistance means the attacker pays a premium for every fake face.
